title: Ebele ya bato oyo basili kolimwa
intro: Otelemi liboso ya ba échos ya communauté oyo lisolo na yango ekomami na mbonge. Milimo wana eyokaki libiangi, eponaki koboya, mpe ekutanaki na mbano oyo ebongisaki lisusu mabele. Bazali banani, mpe mokili na bango ekómaki nini?
clues: Tozalaki na bomoi kala, mpe momemi-nsango moko ayaki epai na biso uta na kati na biso.
Tosambelaki bikeko mitano mpe toboyaki kotika yango.
Tosɛkaki momemi-nsango yango mpe tofundaki ye ete abungaki nzela.
Tosengaki amema etumbu soki azali na bosolo.
Tomonaki likoló esopani mbula mpe mabele ezali kosopana na maziba.
Tomataki na bisika ya likoló mpo na kokima, kasi mbonge elekaki biso.

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Tobomamaki na mopɛpɛ moko ya makasi
Babɛtaki biso mabanga oyo eutaki na likoló

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Biso banso tokufaki longola se bandimi na Nuh
Totikalaki lokola bitika mpo na bato oyo bazalaki kosala mibembo
Bapesaki biso mwa ntango ya kopema
outcome.answer: Biso banso tokufaki longola se bandimi na Nuh

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
